What We Do!

[/et_pb_text][et_pb_text _builder_version=”4.27.4″ text_font=”Work Sans|600|||||||” text_text_color=”#FFFFFF” text_font_size=”16px” text_line_height=”1.4em” custom_margin=”50px||50px||true” locked=”off” global_colors_info=”{}”]

Security doesn’t stop when you go to sleep or leave for the day—and neither do we. At McQuage Security and Electronics, our 24/7 monitoring service ensures that your property is always being watched, no matter the time of day or night. Whether it’s your home or business, we provide around-the-clock coverage that alerts you and the proper authorities the moment something goes wrong.

Our monitoring systems are fast, reliable, and designed to respond in real time, giving you peace of mind whether you’re across town or across the country. From break-ins and motion detection to fire and environmental hazards, we help keep everything under control—even when you can’t be there yourself.

With McQuage, you’re not just getting a security system—you’re getting a dedicated team watching your back 24/7.
